spec.text:
Cool, even early-morning daylight fills the rehearsal studio. A wooden barre lines the rear wall; the level floor is clear. Sela Nori stands with parallel feet and relaxed arms. A continuous, fixed three-quarter full-body view keeps her hands and both shoes visible throughout.

She steps her right foot a short distance forward, keeping it planted through recovery. She lowers into a comfortable crouch over her bent right knee, left palm flat on the floor just inside her right foot, right hand off the floor, left foot behind.

Pressing through her right leg, she lifts her left palm as her left foot steps farther back. She settles into a right-forward lunge, right knee bent, left leg extended behind with heel raised. Her left arm extends forward and her right arm reaches diagonally upward.

She holds the pose, then lowers her arms, lifts her left foot and steps it forward beside the right. She finishes upright ahead of her opening position. The room and camera remain still.

In a community exercise room, Lena Voss stands on clear, level floor, feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly outward, weight evenly supported and arms relaxed at her sides. The fixed camera holds a full-body side-three-quarter view from her front-right, keeping her entire body visible throughout one continuous shot.

Lena bends both knees and eases her hips back, bringing both forearms forward symmetrically with elbows bent. She lowers at a controlled pace into a comfortable two-foot squat, knees tracking over her feet. Both boot soles, including the heels, stay planted throughout; her torso inclines slightly forward for balance.

She holds the squat briefly and steadily, then presses through both feet, straightens her knees and hips, and returns upright while lowering both arms to her sides.

A locked camera in a gallery-hall corner shows Lena Voss already front-facing on the clear floor in an unobstructed full-body view, arms slightly clear of her sides. Floor and wall junctions remain fixed.

Lena turns clockwise in place as viewed from above, reaching a left-facing profile, nose toward frame left, then a rear view. Her forehead scars disappear naturally as she turns away; her braid remains attached on her anatomical right throughout.

Continuing in the same direction, she reaches a right-facing profile, nose toward frame right, then completes the rotation to face the camera. She settles with both boots planted and her arms relaxed slightly away from her jacket. Lena remains entirely in frame throughout this single shot without dialogue; the camera never moves.

A locked, low-set camera holds a full-body view of a plain fitting studio with no mirror. Sela Nori stands facing the camera in the center of the fitting area, visible from head to sneakers. She is the only person present and remains entirely in frame throughout the continuous shot. There is no dialogue or cutting.

To display the bomber’s rear fit, she keeps her arms relaxed beside her body and turns counterclockwise as viewed from above. Small, natural steps and pivots carry her through a profile facing screen right, then into a rear-facing stance. She briefly holds with her back square to the camera, letting the bomber hang naturally.

Rather than completing a full circle, she reverses clockwise through the same right-facing profile until she faces the camera again. She settles with both feet planted in her original fitting position.

At night in a quiet intake room, Anika Sol sits alone on the left, waiting for clearance with a neutral expression, her empty hands resting in her lap. Closed double doors stand on the right beneath one large circular status lamp, initially dark. Red means wait; steady green means clearance. A continuous fixed medium three-quarter view keeps Anika’s face and the lamp readable together throughout.

The lamp begins flashing vivid red. Anika looks diagonally upward toward it. Her eyes widen, eyebrows rise and lips part. Her shoulders tense as she waits.

The red flashing stops; the same lamp turns steady green. Only then do her shoulders relax and eyebrows ease, her parted lips softening into a relieved smile. She holds that expression, remaining seated and watching the green lamp. The doors stay closed and the room’s soft overhead illumination remains unchanged.

In the camera corner of a portrait studio, Sela Nori sits before a plain portrait backdrop. A continuous fixed medium close-up shows her head and upper torso; she is alone, clearly identifiable from the opening, and remains in frame throughout. There is no dialogue.

As a deliberate portrait warm-up, she practices a gradual smile, keeping her head steady and her gaze toward the lens. She begins neutral, her mouth resting naturally and her eyes calm. After a brief beat, her mouth corners lift into a small, clearly closed-mouth smile.

Without moving her head, she gradually broadens the smile into a warm, natural expression. Her cheeks lift gently while her eyes stay relaxed. She holds the broader smile for several beats.

A continuous fixed wide three-quarter view holds on an empty field-station room. No part of Noor Hale is initially in frame. The closed, unlatched door at left, clear connecting floor, and low inspection console at right remain visible. The door is hinged at its left jamb, with room to swing inward toward the left wall without blocking the route. The console is angled to keep Noor's face readable at the controls.

The door starts inward under pressure from outside. Noor Hale's right hand becomes visible pressing its outer face near the free edge at handle height. She pushes it clear of the passage, releases it, and crosses fully inside before walking right toward the console. The door stays open beside the left wall.

Her attention settles on the controls as she arrives. Noor stops close enough to examine them, facing the controls with her face readable in three-quarter profile. She remains in frame from her entrance through this final pause.

The gallery foyer is empty. A fixed wide view holds the open archway on the right and waist-high visitor welcome desk on the left. The arch, threshold and floor immediately inside are fully visible. The clear visitor approach crosses the open foyer between arch and desk. The desk’s right-hand end is unobstructed, with ample standing room behind it.

Lena Voss enters through the right arch and clears it completely, both boots beyond the threshold and her whole figure visible before she approaches the desk.

She walks left, passes around the desk’s open right-hand end with room to spare, and stands behind it, facing the visitor approach across the open foyer. She remains within the fixed frame throughout her entrance and walk, then holds her position behind the desk.

A continuous fixed wide shot, without cuts or dialogue, spans a quiet training ward. Anika Sol stands clearly visible at screen-left, looking toward the basin on the right-hand wall. A wide opaque divider occupies the center, extending above her head to the floor without a gap. An open rear path connects its ends; the entire route stays within frame.

Anika walks left to right behind the divider's left edge until her entire silhouette, including hair and boots, is concealed. She remains completely hidden across its broad center, then emerges at its right edge.

She continues to the basin and stops facing it in profile, her face identifiable and medical clothing clearly visible; the basin does not obscure her.

A locked wide three-quarter view holds the station corridor, from near-right foreground to an inspection panel on the far-left rear wall. Noor Hale stands clearly visible near-right in left-facing profile.

A broad opaque equipment enclosure stands between the camera and rear aisle. Its housing rises above Noor's head; a solid floor-level plinth closes any view underneath. Behind it, ample walking clearance accommodates a concealed bend from leftward travel into a diagonal farther left and away toward the panel. Noor's entire route remains within the fixed frame.

Noor walks left behind the enclosure's right end and disappears completely. Fully hidden, she follows the aisle around its bend, changing heading toward the panel.

She first reappears beyond the enclosure's farther-left end already moving diagonally away in rear-three-quarter orientation. Without another turn, she clears the enclosure and continues along that same diagonal to the panel, growing slightly smaller with distance.

A continuous fixed-camera shot frames Tomas Reed knees-up in a workshop vestibule beside a closed workshop door. He faces the camera, his face and open vest clearly visible.

He brings the vest edges together near his chest, aligning two large buttons on his right front panel with matching buttonholes on his left front panel. He guides the upper button through its matching hole and secures it, then fastens the lower button through its matching hole, closing the opening.

With both buttons secured, he releases both hands from the fastenings. He places his palms against the vest front, smooths downward, then lowers his arms to his sides. The vest stays closed.

He remains in place, visible knees-up throughout; nobody enters. There is no dialogue.

A continuous fixed medium three-quarter view shows Esme Park on a sheltered porch beside an open exit at frame right, her face visible and her hood down behind her neck. Light rain falls only beyond the shelter, leaving Esme and the porch beneath her dry.

Esme reaches back with both hands, each grasping the corresponding hood edge. She lifts it behind her head, clearing her hair, then draws it forward into place. The opening frames her unobstructed face, with silver hair still visible along her forehead and temples. She releases both edges and lowers her hands.

Only then does Esme turn her gaze toward the exit. The hood stays up unsupported. She remains dry in the same spot, continuously in frame; apart from the raised hood, her clothing and appearance remain unchanged.

A continuous fixed wide view shows a rehearsal hall with a wall-mounted barre across the right side of the rear wall. Only Sela Nori and Tomas Reed are present, both fully visible and identifiable at the opening. Tomas sits on a sturdy stool at far left, both feet on the floor and hands on his thighs; Sela stands left of center, well to his right.

Sela walks left to right along an unobstructed route, well clear of the stool. At the barre’s right-hand end, she turns toward the barre and stops facing it, ready without beginning an exercise.

Tomas remains seated, feet on the floor and hands on his thighs; he may blink or make small balance adjustments. Both remain within the fixed wide frame with separate silhouettes throughout. There is no dialogue or camera cut.

A fixed wide view holds a gallery with a solid, closed exit door on the left and a waiting bench against the rear wall, clear of the open walkway. Lena Voss stands at the right end of the walkway; Esme Park waits beside the bench in a relaxed, balanced stance, outside Lena Voss’s route. Both adults are clearly visible and identifiable.

Lena Voss walks from right to left along the unobstructed walkway to the door. Lena Voss stops facing its latch and looks at it, checking the exit without opening the door.

Esme Park remains standing beside the bench. Both remain visible within the fixed frame throughout the continuous scene.

Exhibition preparation room, day. A clear aisle separates two work areas. At the opening, Lena Voss is fully visible beside the screen-left workbench, holding one lightweight closed folder. Anika Sol is fully visible at screen-right, arms relaxed. One continuous fixed full-body three-quarter view keeps both in frame, their faces and hands clear of furniture and the transfer unobstructed. Anika's left-chest badge and cross remain visible.

Lena walks across the aisle carrying the folder. Within comfortable reach, she presents it between them, holding one edge and leaving the other free. Anika securely grips the free edge; both briefly support the same folder. Only then does Lena release her edge and draw her empty hands back. Anika keeps holding it.

Lena turns toward the screen-left workbench and walks back to her work area, increasing their distance. Anika stays at her original location with the folder.

A fixed, full-body side-three-quarter view holds a rehearsal hall with an open, level stage area at rear left. A floor tape cross marks Sela Nori’s stage position. Sela Nori and Noor Hale are identifiable and fully visible from the opening, Sela Nori several paces left of Noor Hale.

Noor Hale waits on the right, facing Sela Nori. Rehearsing a greeting, Sela Nori approaches and stops facing Noor Hale about a metre and a half away. They exchange shallow bows, hinging forward at the hips with relaxed arms, their heads well apart.

Both straighten fully and pause upright before Sela Nori turns back toward the stage and walks away toward the tape cross. Noor Hale remains in place. Only these two are present, both unobstructed and visible head to toe throughout one continuous shot, without dialogue or cuts.

A fixed wide side view frames a station hall: low desk left, waist-high console right, with parallel near and far walking lanes between them. Neither workstation obstructs the lanes or workers’ bodies.

Initially, Anika Sol stands left in the near lane and Noor Hale right in the far lane, both fully visible and identifiable. Anika Sol walks right toward the console as Noor Hale walks left toward the desk, approaching center together without changing lanes, slowing or turning aside.

Anika Sol passes in front, briefly masking part of Noor Hale’s torso. Through the changing gap between Anika Sol’s strides, Noor Hale’s moving lower legs are intermittently visible. Their depth separation prevents contact.

Anika Sol stops beside the right console in the near lane; Noor Hale stops beside the left desk in the far lane, both bodies readable. Both workers remain within the fixed frame throughout.

A fixed wide side view holds the gallery foyer: left arch, right doorway, and open floor between. Sela Nori and Lena Voss, both adults, are fully visible and recognizable from the opening. Sela Nori is left in the farther lane; Lena Voss is right in the nearer lane.

Leaving rehearsal, Sela Nori walks toward the right doorway while Lena Voss walks toward the left arch along parallel lanes. At the middle, Lena Voss passes in front of Sela Nori, nearer the camera. Neither changes lanes or turns around; both continue in their original directions.

Lena Voss stops on the left a pace short of the arch; Sela Nori stops on the right a pace short of the doorway. Both remain inside the foyer and in frame throughout.

A continuous fixed medium-wide view holds the station observation room, its broad observation window and right-side workbench. Noor Hale and Mara Vale are fully visible and identifiable with unobstructed faces; both remain in frame throughout. Noor stands near center, with Mara to Noor’s left.

The outage has ended: the previously dark raised articulated work lamp is already steadily lit in the upper-right, its shade aimed onto the workbench. Soft ambient light keeps exposure stable, without flashes or brightness changes.

Checking the workbench lighting, Mara initially watches Noor. Noor notices the illuminated surface, looks up to the lamp and raises the anatomical right hand to point diagonally upper-right, keeping the arm clear of Mara’s face. Mara shifts her gaze from Noor to the lamp, turning her head just enough to inspect it while her face remains visible, then smiles with relief at its steady illumination across the workbench. Noor keeps pointing as Mara holds her gaze on the lamp. No dialogue or cuts.

A fixed medium-wide view holds continuously on a quiet gallery before opening. A completed, brightly colored sculpture on a broad, stable rear-left plinth dominates the upper-left, clearly visible from the start.

Lena Voss and Juno Pike stand fully visible at center and right, respectively, with unobstructed sightlines to the sculpture. Juno Pike initially faces Lena Voss, their face visible in three-quarter view.

Lena Voss looks upper-left and brightens, then raises her anatomical right arm, pointing directly at the sculpture with her hand clear of Juno Pike’s face. Juno Pike follows the gesture with their eyes, then turns their head and shoulders toward the sculpture without changing position. Juno Pike smiles appreciatively; Lena Voss smiles too, holding her point for a quiet beat.

Both remain visible in their original places through the final hold; no one enters or leaves. No dialogue or cuts.

Day, training demonstration room. A workbench holds one empty lightweight tray. A short section of the workbench's near rim is wet with fresh ochre paint; the remaining work surface is dry. Anika Sol stands at the tray. Sela Nori waits beyond the workbench's opposite end, outside reach of the painted section.

The continuous fixed medium two-shot shows both faces, Anika Sol's forearms and the painted rim.

Anika Sol slides the tray aside to clear space. Her exposed right burgundy undersleeve cuff brushes the wet workbench rim. She withdraws, notices the new ochre mark and briefly holds the cuff clear of the bench. Sela Nori looks at the stain.

Anika Sol lowers her arm and continues arranging the tray. The mark remains only on that cuff; her white outer sleeve and Sela Nori's clothing stay clean.

A continuous fixed medium two-shot holds the sheltered station porch and its open station doorway. Noor Hale stands left near the porch exit, preparing to leave; Ivo Sen waits right just inside the doorway. Both are clearly visible under shelter and remain in frame throughout.

Noor's jacket starts open. Looking down, Noor brings the existing fronts together, aligning the two reachable buttons with their matching buttonholes. Their left hand steadies the fabric while their right hand works the upper button through its hole, then fastens the lower button. The fronts overlap naturally without distorting the jacket.

Noor releases the jacket and lowers both hands. Only then does Ivo glance at the buttoned front, remaining in place with his clothing unchanged. Noor turns their gaze toward the porch exit, ready to leave, with the same jacket remaining buttoned.

A fixed wide side view holds a straight service walk, a slim post near the middle and a closed inspection gate twelve metres farther right. Lena Voss and Tomas Reed are already fully visible, walking rightward with their anatomical right sides toward the camera. Lena leads by about three metres, with the post two metres ahead. Both walkers and both landmarks remain visible throughout this continuous shot, without dialogue.

Lena walks steadily past the post toward the gate. Tomas follows the same route; only after passing the post does he lengthen his stride into a quicker walk. Lena maintains pace as Tomas gradually closes the gap; both keep walking, and he never draws level or overtakes.

With about one metre between them and several metres before the gate, Tomas shortens his stride to match Lena's pace for a few steps. Lena then gently decelerates; Tomas slows with her, preserving the gap. They stop completely before the closed gate, Lena still ahead.

A continuous fixed wide side view shows a rehearsal hall’s straight leftward route: mat corner, floor seam, then closed interior practice-room door. Ample clear floor separates seam and door; the mat stays outside the lane.

Sela Nori and Esme Park start fully visible right of the mat corner, Sela Nori slightly ahead, nearer the door. Sela Nori walks left past the corner; Esme Park follows along the same route, passing it afterward. Esme Park slows while Sela Nori continues steadily; their gap grows while both move.

Sela Nori crosses the seam first, then Esme Park. Only after both pass it does Sela Nori stop short of the door. Esme Park stops farther back, leaving a generous clear gap. Neither touches or opens the door. Both remain in frame throughout, without reversal or route change.
